en_title: God of War Laufey Features Kratos in an Ancient Greek Setting, Sparking Speculation Over the Game's Story — and Praise for His Big Bushy Beard
subtitle: 奎托斯又出现了
opus_summary: 《战神：劳菲》公布新截图，劳菲与奎托斯现身疑似古希腊神庙的场景。由于劳菲已死且从未到过古希腊，玩家纷纷猜测截图的时间与地点；游戏将于2027年2月16日登陆PS5。

paragraphs.en: Fans are discussing a new God of War Laufey screenshot featuring fan-favorite hero Kratos, in a setting resembling Ancient Greece.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝们正在讨论《战神：劳菲》的一张新截图，深受玩家喜爱的英雄奎托斯现身于一个看起来像古希腊的场景中。

paragraphs.en: The image was revealed today via the PlayStation blog , alongside details of the game's preorder bonuses and digital deluxe edition. The screenshot shows Laufey's eponymous heroine with Kratos, with the pair standing in what looks to be a Greek temple.
paragraphs.cn: 这张图片于今日通过PlayStation博客公开，同时公布的还有游戏预购奖励和数字豪华版的详情。截图中，游戏同名女主角劳菲与奎托斯一同现身，两人站在一处看起来像希腊神庙的地方。

paragraphs.en: Why is this interesting? Well, because Laufey is supposed to be dead and separated from Kratos, and she never visited Ancient Greece during his time there, which occured long before they met. So, what's going on?
paragraphs.cn: 这有什么特别之处？原因在于，劳菲按理说已经死去，并且与奎托斯分隔两地；而在奎托斯身处古希腊期间，她从未去过那里——那段经历发生在两人相识很久以前。那么，究竟发生了什么？

paragraphs.en: Firstly, while Laufey is very much the star of this new game, fans have already seen Kratos pop up a couple of times at its beginning, in footage released back when the game was revealed in June . First, the bearded demigod can be seen burning Laufey's body on a funeral pyre, an event which took place at the start of the 2018 God of War game.
paragraphs.cn: 首先，虽然劳菲无疑是这款新作的主角，但粉丝已经在游戏开头的几处画面中见过奎托斯。相关影像是在游戏于6月公布时发布的。首先可以看到，这位留着胡须的半神正在火葬柴堆上焚烧劳菲的遗体，而这一幕发生在2018年《战神》的开头。

paragraphs.en: Laufey then re-awakens in the Everywhen — a heavenly place that serves as an afterlife for gods of all mythologies — and it's here that Kratos visits her again in a moment of need, albeit only momentarily. When this scene was shown earlier this year, however, it was not clear if Kratos would feature further in the game, or this was something of a one-off.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，劳菲在Everywhen中重新苏醒。Everywhen是一处天界，充当各类神话中诸神的死后世界。奎托斯也在劳菲需要帮助时再次前往那里与她见面，不过停留时间很短。然而，这一幕于今年早些时候公开时，外界还不清楚奎托斯是否会继续出现在游戏中，还是说这只是一次性的登场。

paragraphs.en: Today's screenshot answers that question, but then asks several more. Which version of Kratos is this? Is it the version that's still alive and living through the events of 2018's God of War and its sequel Ragnarök? If so, when exactly in his timeline does this take place? Alternatively, could this be a version of Kratos that has also found himself in the Everywhen via other means (perhaps after his eventual final death)?
paragraphs.cn: 今天公开的截图回答了这个问题，却又引出了更多疑问。这是哪一个版本的奎托斯？是仍然活着、正在经历2018年《战神》及其续作《战神：诸神黄昏》故事的那个版本吗？如果是，这一幕究竟发生在他的时间线中的哪个阶段？又或者，这可能是另一个通过其他方式来到Everywhen的奎托斯版本——比如在他最终死去之后？

paragraphs.en: And what about that Ancient Greek setting? Is this a corner of the Everywhen that Laufey will visit, themed around Greek mythology? Will other familiar faces from the first God of War trilogy make a reappearance here too?
paragraphs.cn: 那么，古希腊场景又是怎么回事？这会不会是Everywhen中的某个区域，主题围绕希腊神话展开，而劳菲将前往那里？初代《战神》三部曲中的其他熟悉面孔，也会在这里再次登场吗？

paragraphs.en: "Where the hell are they?" God of War fan Iluminado_Horn wrote on video game forum ResetEra. "In Greece? After Ragnarok?"
paragraphs.cn: 《战神》粉丝Iluminado_Horn在电子游戏论坛ResetEra上写道：「他们到底在哪里？在希腊？还是在诸神黄昏之后？」

paragraphs.en: "Laufey dreams/hallucinates of Kratos, it was shown on the gameplay reveal," responded another fan, Patitoloco. "This could be anywhere in the game, or a flashback."
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝Patitoloco回复道：「实机演示中已经展示过，劳菲梦见或幻觉中看到了奎托斯。这可能发生在游戏的任何地方，也可能是一段闪回。」

paragraphs.en: Last, but certainly not least, this image has sparked praise for Kratos' exquisitely bushy beard, which has been rendered on PlayStation 5 Pro in fine detail. While this isn't our first time gazing at the game running on PS5 Pro, it is certainly impressive when you take a moment to appreciate it.
paragraphs.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，这张图片还引来了玩家对奎托斯浓密胡须的称赞。PlayStation 5 Pro将这撮胡须的细节呈现得十分精致。虽然这不是我们第一次看到游戏在PS5 Pro上运行，但只要停下来仔细欣赏片刻，依然会觉得相当惊艳。

paragraphs.en: God of War Laufey will launch exclusively for PlayStation 5 early next year, on February 16, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《战神：劳菲》将于明年年初，也就是2027年2月16日，登陆PS5独占发售。
